opt:body.p: Every web component the site is built from, shown with its states and variants so their look can be planned before content lands. Each entry links to a page with the full set, and the component palette renders a live example of each, side by side. The palette specimen shows the design tokens the components draw on, in both themes.
opt:body.opt:callout: Every component type the site plans to build with is now here, including the A-Frame scene integration; refinements land as the content pages start using them.

ul.li: Callout: highlighted notes, tips and warnings
Badge: compact status markers
Card: titled content containers
Details: collapsible sections
Key-value: label/value pairs for specs and metadata
Table: tabular data in a scrollable frame
Source: labelled code blocks with a copy control
Timeline: dated events with status dots
Empty state: placeholders for absent content
KPI: single measurements, data-forward
Steps: numbered procedures with states
Tree: collapsible hierarchies
Film: frame-by-frame playback of a recorded interaction
Machine: an interaction machine's transition diagram
Term: a classification from a controlled vocabulary, look derived from meaning
Interaction reports: every control driven through its machine with real input, rendered with these elements
Button: actions with primary and danger weights
Input: labelled text entry
Select: labelled native selects
Checkbox: native checkboxes
Switch: immediate on/off settings
Tooltip: hover and focus annotations
Chip: interactive filter tokens
Progress: determinate and indeterminate bars
Tabs: tabbed regions with keyboard activation
Breadcrumb: where-am-I trails
Pagination: page navigation for split lists
Scene: embedded A-Frame scenes with Rust-driven behaviour
